shots.typography: Bold geometric sans, white, lowercase single words very large and centered ('new', 'adventures'); the library line is sentence case, two lines, medium-bold, tight tracking; the same line is shown huge and blurred as the camera flies through it; small regular-weight disclaimer bottom centre. Font guess (low confidence): Meta's Optimistic Display.
shots.what_happens: Single caption words land over first-person VR gameplay (a hand catching a glowing mushroom on a night rooftop, then a hand on Venetian roof tiles). The rooftop clip shrinks into a rounded card on a pale blue gradient and dozens of gameplay cards fly toward camera in depth; the camera pushes through oversized blurred caption text, which resolves into 'From the world's best library of immersive content' sitting among the cards. The whole card plane then tilts diagonally and sweeps out bottom-left, leaving 'But there's more' drifting on the empty gradient as new cards begin to enter from the top-right.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the full-frame clip down into a rounded-corner card on a soft blue gradient, spawn 30+ video cards on a 3D z-spread with depth-of-field blur, dolly the camera through a blur-in headline, then rotate the card plane ~25 degrees and translate it out bottom-left while a small sentence-case caption drifts in its place.

shots.typography: White bold geometric sans captions, sentence case, single or two centered lines; 'Play your favorite Xbox games' builds word by word with 'favorite' entering larger/blurred before settling; tiny two-line legal disclaimer bottom centre; Game Pass wordmark in heavy uppercase sans with logo top-left.
shots.what_happens: The Roblox caption holds over the avatar plaza and then a sunny Roblox city street. The street clip shrinks into a rounded card that rotates and slides off top-left across the pale gradient, while a second tilted card (person on a sofa holding an Xbox controller) swings in and straightens to full frame. 'Play your favorite Xbox games' builds in at centre with a legal disclaimer at the bottom, and by the end the frame shows a Game Pass title playing on a large curved virtual screen in a living room.
shots.build_rebuild: Shrink and rotate the outgoing clip into a rounded card that exits top-left on a gradient while the incoming clip enters as a counter-rotated card and eases to full-bleed (rotation and radius to 0), then stagger the caption words in with a blur-to-sharp scale on the key word.
